newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HOIU SHARES LEAP ON NEW FORECASTS.
newsitem.headline: HOIU SHARES LEAP ON NEW FORECASTS.

text.p: Hoiupank shares rose sharply on news of a revised profit forecast for the bank and the group.
The shares were 11.50 kroons higher at 248.25 kroons by 1030 GMT, compared with only around a two kroon rise in early trade.
Hoiupank said that its group's new profit forecast is 297.5 million kroons compared to 140 million kroons.
The bank's new forecast is 208 million kroons from 113 million kroons.
"We had expected a doubling of their profit forecast and the market has responded to it in a big way," one trader said.
"The company's subsidiaries are doing very well and this has helped their results," he added.
